lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy noir parody: a private detective investigates a used Camry that turned out to have spent a month at the bottom of a river. Deadpan noir narration, like an old detective film. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Line 1: panicked, defensive, quick. Line 2: cheeky, salesman-like, proud of his excuse.

gor.profile: Gorokhov — a seasoned Russian private detective in his 50s, film-noir style: low, slow, raspy, dramatic, dead serious about absurd evidence.
gor.notes: Every line deadpan and dramatic, with noir pauses. Line 'Ил. Песок. И… карась. Живой.' — slow, each word separate. 'Дело закрыто.' — final, solemn.

olga.profile: Olga — a Russian woman around 35, the detective's client, emotional and expressive.
olga.notes: Line 1: worried, telling her story. Line 2: shocked, high. Line 3: happy, relieved, a bit ironic.
